finalText:
**Redis went down and took the service with it.**

`redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` at 02:14:07, [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). Cache fell back to direct store reads. All 13 reconnect tries failed the same way. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568, cap 500. 173 timeouts followed. `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at 02:31:44. Supervisor killed `api` at 02:31:52. The log ends there. No recovery.

Check the Redis box at `10.0.0.12:6379`. That is the root cause, not the app code.
